finding: Pollinations.ai: unlimited, no key, URL-based. Stability AI free tier: 25 credits/day. Hugging Face Inference: rate-limited but free.
Ollama + Llama 3.1 8B runs on Mac Mini M-series. 4-bit quantized fits in 4GB RAM. Good enough for agent routing and research summarization.
Piper TTS: offline, 100+ voices, <200ms latency. Coqui TTS: higher quality but heavier. Edge TTS (Microsoft): free, cloud-based, very natural.
Web Speech API: free in Chrome/Edge, supports continuous recognition. No install, no API key. Works over Tailscale to Mac Mini.
